title: Winsorized burst reservoir and adaptive latency safeguard for Dedicated fleets
author: Ava Kim
description:
Motivation: large ephemeral spikes (microbursts) in tenant traffic were disproportionately skewing reservoir accounting and causing the Dedicated fleet autoscaler to over-commit warm capacity. This PR introduces a winsorized reservoir for burst accounting and an adaptive latency safeguard that gates aggressive burst allocation when p99 latency moves outside a configurable band. The goals are: reduce false positives for long-lived reserve allocation, keep tail latency within SLOs, and provide deterministic telemetry for downstream billing and debugging.

What this PR adds (high level): winsorized burst reservoir: an online estimator that clips extreme outliers before computing short-window reserved demand; reservoir decay tuned to per-tenant traffic envelopes; configurable clip-percentile and safety-margin fields. adaptive latency safeguard: observes per-pool latency histograms and reduces burst issuance aggressiveness when p99 > configured threshold or when p95/p50 ratio indicates high skew. smoother allocation ramp: a gentle ramp multiplier that limits immediate provisioned slots to X% of estimated winsorized demand to avoid oscillation. telemetry and audits: new metrics (burst_reservoir_clip_count, winsorized_demand, latency_guard_state) and a debug trace for per-allocation decision trees.

Design notes and tradeoffs: winsorizing reduces sensitivity to transient extreme requests (e.g., one-off batched jobs) but can hide genuine sustained shifts if clip-percentile is tuned too aggressively; default clip-percentile is 99.5 to only affect the most extreme samples. The latency safeguard intentionally biases towards latency safety over short-term throughput; if a customer has strict throughput commitments this can be tuned per-reservation profile.

Files changed (summary): core autoscaler loop, burst allocator, pool controller, telemetry exporter, unit tests, documentation snippets with config examples.

Checklist: [x] unit tests for winsorized estimator and scheduler logic; [x] integration test that simulates microburst; [x] e2e in perf-canary against a two-pool cluster; [x] docs updated with config knobs and recommended presets; [x] tracing for allocation decisions.

Related: ENG-7321 (reduce false warmup commits), ENG-7384 (latency-first throttling), SUP-4417 (customer incident: spike-driven overcommit 2026-01).

review_comments: Diego Morales: Overall this looks sound. Two nits: 1) consider adding a 'min_samples' config to avoid winsorizing on tiny windows; 2) document the expected memory footprint of histogram collectors.
Ava Kim (author): replied: added min_samples with default=200 and documented memory expectations in burst_metrics.go header. Also added a test for min_samples behavior.
Priya Shah: Requested change: adjust the default clip-percentile from 99.9 to 99.5 after looking at production traces — added rationale?
Ava Kim: Updated defaults and added an explanation in docs/burst-control.md about why 99.5 is safer for mixed-traffic customers.
Luca Fontana: Approved after seeing integration test results; asked for a follow-up to add canary gating to Dedicated rollout (we tracked as ENG-7479).
QA (Marina Ortiz): Passed e2e in perf-canary (2 pools): latency degradation < 3% and warm pool commits reduced by 22% on microburst workload.
merge_outcome: squash-merge: commits squashed into a single change; release gated behind feature flag 'winsorized_burst_v1' for gradual rollout
release_notes: Introduces a winsorized reservoir for burst accounting to reduce over-commit during transient spikes, an adaptive latency safeguard that throttles burst issuance when tail latency degrades, and a smoothing ramp to avoid oscillation. Telemetry keys: winsorized_demand, burst_reservoir_clip_count, latency_guard_state. Default knobs are conservative; see docs for tuning.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind 'winsorized_burst_v1' feature flag. Recommended rollout: enable in staging for 48h, then 10% of Dedicated fleet, monitor p99 latency and burst_warm_commits metric. If latency_guard_state flips to PROBING frequently, increase ramp_multiplier or raise latency threshold.

ENG-7564: add customer-visible telemetry endpoint for winsorized_demand per-tenant
